paragraphs.text: Monkey is a creature type used for depictions of the animals commonly called monkeys and of fantastical and artificial monkey-like creatures. Monkeys are distinguished from apes (which use the Ape and Human creature types) by their quadrupedal builds, relatively smaller brains, tree-canopy habitats, and tails.

The Monkey subtype was introduced in 1998, but was removed from the game from 2005 until 2016; during this period, the Ape subtype encompassed both monkeys and apes (excluding humans ). Most Monkey cards are green or red .

The first two Monkey cards were Tree Monkey ( Portal Second Age , 1998) and Zodiac Monkey ( Portal Three Kingdoms , 1999). Both cards were reprinted into Ninth Edition (2005), where they were changed to Apes, and the Monkey subtype was removed from the game. This followed a pattern of consolidating creature types .

Kaladesh (2016) reintroduced the Monkey type with the printing of Wily Bandar . The Kaladesh Oracle update changed Tree Monkey, Zodiac Monkey, Ravenous Baboons , and the tokens created by Monkey Cage from Apes to Monkeys. These changes were made to match the actual definitions of monkey and ape . Two silver-bordered Ape cards, Monkey Monkey Monkey and Tainted Monkey , were likewise changed to Monkeys during the Unstable Oracle update. One card, Hooting Mandrills , remains an Ape despite portraying a type of monkey .
